end.summary:
Yash practised ordering cell, tissue, organ, organ system, organism and showed the order in a new situation.
Yash practised human and plant examples at each level; a why or new-situation check is still needed for plant examples.
Yash practised how parts at one level affect the whole; this is still building.
Yash first mixed up the heart and circulatory system, then corrected the idea with stomach and digestive system; the mix-up returned in the final turn.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the levels of organisation with Yash using human and plant examples, including the heart, stomach, leaf, xylem and nervous system. Yash showed the correct order and corrected the heart-versus-circulatory-system idea earlier by identifying the heart as one organ within a system. The same distinction came up again at the end, so it needs another check next time. At home, ask Yash to explain one human and one plant example using “part, group of parts, and whole” and to say what may happen if one part is blocked or damaged.
